name: Annual gas boiler service
description: Full annual service and safety check of a gas boiler, including flue gas analysis and a written service record. Keeps the manufacturer warranty valid.

name: Boiler breakdown and repair
description: Diagnosis and repair of a faulty boiler: no heating, no hot water, error codes, pressure loss, noises or pilot light problems.
price_note: £85 covers the visit, diagnosis and first hour of labour; further labour £65 per hour. Parts are extra and quoted before fitting.

name: Combi boiler replacement
description: Supply and installation of a new A-rated combi boiler, including removal of the old boiler, system flush, magnetic filter and smart-ready controls.
price_note: Depends on boiler model, flue position and pipework. Fixed quote given after a free survey. Up to 10-year manufacturer warranty.

name: System or regular boiler replacement
description: Supply and installation of a new system or regular (heat-only) boiler for homes with a hot water cylinder.
price_note: Fixed quote given after a free survey. Cylinder replacement, if needed, is quoted separately.

name: Landlord gas safety certificate (CP12)
description: Annual landlord gas safety check of all gas appliances, flues and pipework, with the CP12 certificate emailed the same day.
price_note: £75 per property including one appliance; £15 for each additional gas appliance.

name: Gas hob or cooker connection
description: Safe connection and testing of a gas hob, cooker or range cooker, including removal of the old appliance connection.
price_note: Range cookers and any new gas pipework at the higher end.

name: Unvented hot water cylinder service
description: Annual safety service of an unvented hot water cylinder (e.g. Megaflo), including expansion vessel and safety valve checks.
price_note: Fixed price per cylinder. £200 when booked together with an annual boiler service.

name: Central heating power flush
description: Power flush of the central heating system to remove sludge, with inhibitor added afterwards. Fixes cold spots and noisy radiators.
price_note: Depends on the number of radiators (up to 8 radiators at the lower end).

name: Radiator supply and fit
description: Supply and fit of a new or replacement radiator, including valves and system refill.
price_note: Per radiator. Designer and column radiators quoted separately.

name: Smart thermostat installation
description: Supply and installation of a smart thermostat (e.g. Hive, Nest or tado), set up and connected to the customer's phone.
price_note: Includes the thermostat; price depends on the model chosen.

name: Leak detection and repair
description: Finding and fixing leaks from pipes, joints, radiators, appliances or under sinks, including small sections of replacement pipe.
price_note: Hidden leaks needing floor or wall access are at the higher end; making good of plaster or tiles is extra.

name: Burst or frozen pipe repair
description: Repair of burst, split or frozen pipes. Outside working hours this is attended as an emergency call-out.
price_note: In working hours. Out of hours, emergency call-out rates apply.

name: Blocked sink, toilet or drain clearance
description: Clearing blocked sinks, basins, baths, toilets and internal waste pipes. External drains up to the boundary.
price_note: Jobs needing a drain camera survey are at the higher end.

name: Tap repair or replacement
description: Fixing dripping or stiff taps, or fitting new kitchen and bathroom taps (customer-supplied or ours).
price_note: Lower end for washer or cartridge repairs; higher end for replacement taps including supply.

name: Toilet and cistern repair
description: Repair of running or leaking toilets, faulty flushes, fill valves and cistern seals.

name: Outside tap installation
description: Installation of an outside tap with a double check valve and isolation valve inside.

name: Shower installation
description: Installation or replacement of an electric or mixer shower. Electrical connection for electric showers by our partner electrician.
price_note: Like-for-like replacements at the lower end; new showers needing pipework, tiling or a new electrical circuit at the higher end.

name: Full bathroom refit
description: Complete bathroom design and refit: strip-out, plumbing, tiling, suite, shower or bath, and finishing.
price_note: Depends on room size and the suite and tiles chosen. Free design visit and fixed written quote. 25% deposit to book.

name: Emergency call-out (24/7)
description: Urgent attendance for burst pipes, uncontrollable leaks, flooding, or total loss of heating or hot water in vulnerable households. Available 24 hours a day.
price_note: £120 call-out including the first hour; then £80 per hour. Parts extra. Same rates day or night.
